description: Add an always-visible surface service guidance readout so players understand why depot/shop actions are disabled underground and what Enter/Space will do at the surface.
steps: Use and consult miner-daily-task-runner before implementing; run ./init.sh, play the current game, and confirm the underground state where Sell/Refuel/Repair/upgrade buttons are disabled without an explicit depot-distance/status explanation.

Inspect src/ui.tsx, src/dom.ts, src/game.ts, src/economy.ts, src/balance.ts, src/styles.css, and existing UI/economy tests for current HUD text, shop-button state, surfaceService(), sell(), refuel(), repair(), and atSurface() behavior.

Add a DOM-free helper that formats a concise service-status message from player/cash/cargo/surface state, covering at-surface actions (sell cargo, refuel, repair, or all serviced) and underground guidance (return to the surface depot for selling, repairs, refuel, and upgrades).

Extend the React HUD with a stable service-status DOM hook near the shop or cargo feedback, wire src/dom.ts and the HUD update loop to refresh it each frame, and keep existing DOM IDs/classes consumed by the runtime intact.
Style the readout so it is readable on desktop and narrow/mobile layouts without overlapping the stats, sound status, bars, shop, toast, or Info / Cargo overlay.

Add or update unit tests for the service-status helper and React shell markup, including an underground disabled-shop guidance case and at-surface action cases for cargo sale and service/refuel/repair priority.

Run ./init.sh and perform a live browser/CDP smoke that starts the game, moves underground, observes the guidance while shop buttons are disabled, returns or resets to surface to observe the surface action copy, and reports no runtime exceptions.
acceptance: During live gameplay underground, the HUD clearly explains that depot services and upgrades require returning to the surface instead of only showing disabled shop buttons.

At the surface, the readout changes to the next useful action, such as selling loaded cargo, pressing Space/using buttons to refuel or repair, or confirming the ship is fully serviced when cargo is empty and fuel/hull are full.
Keyboard shortcuts Enter and Space, existing button enable/disable logic, Info / Cargo guide, sound affordance, intro flow, and mobile HUD readability remain intact with no runtime exceptions.
Before marking complete, run ./test.sh plus canonical verification npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm run build.
